TotalCows.definition: The total number of cows that need to be transported

HelicopterCapacity.definition: The number of cows that a helicopter can transport per trip

HelicopterPollution.definition: The amount of pollution created by a helicopter per trip

TruckCapacity.definition: The number of cows that a truck can transport per trip

TruckPollution.definition: The amount of pollution created by a truck per trip

MaxTruckTrips.definition: The maximum number of truck trips that can be made due to budget constraints
